faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Russian Blue?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-12 lb (3-5.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a kitten Russian Blue?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Dental disease; Obesity if free-fed; Bladder issues. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 1-2 weeks on the same scale while a Russian Blue is growing, with the number saved beside vaccine dates.
